Title: Greater storage capacity and performance with new Azure Disks SKU

Body.Content:
Larger Azure Managed Disks Sizes now generally available

Pricing |  Azure Disks webpage  

We are announcing the general availability of new Azure Managed Disks SKUs with increased storage capacity and performance in Azure Public Cloud.  

  Specifically:   

  • All existing Azure Managed Disk offerings (Premium SSD, Standard SSD and Standard HDD) will now feature 8, 16 and 32 TiB disk sizes  
  • Premium SSD performance will now reach up to 20,000 IOPS and 900MBps  
  • Standard SSD performance will now reach up to 6,000 IOPS and 750MBps and Standard HDD to 2000 IOPS and 500MBps  

These new SKUs will allow you to significantly expand storage capacity while simplifying management and achieving better performance.  

The new SKUs are now available in all regions under Azure Public Cloud. Support for national clouds including Azure US Government, and China 21Vianet clouds will be available in the coming month. For more information please refer to the blog or the Azure Disks FAQ.
